question: In 2016, Yamini Krishnamurthy received the Padma Vibhushan for her contribution to which fields of classical dance?
solution:
The correct answer is __**Bharatanatyam and Kuchipudi**__.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] __Key Points__

__
 
• **Yamini Krishnamurthy** is renowned for her exceptional proficiency in both Bharatanatyam and Kuchipudi dance forms.
 
• She has significantly contributed to the **preservation and promotion of classical dance** in India and internationally.
 
• Her performances are characterized by **grace, precision, and intense emotion** that resonate with audiences worldwide.
 
• In recognition of her immense contribution to Indian classical dance, she was awarded the **Padma Vibhushan** in 2016, India's second-highest civilian award.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__**

 
• **Bharatanatyam**

 
 
• Bharatanatyam is one of the oldest classical dance forms of India, originating from Tamil Nadu.
 
• It is known for its fixed upper torso, bent legs, and intricate footwork, along with expressive hand gestures and facial expressions.
 
• Bharatanatyam has its roots in the **Natyashastra**, an ancient treatise on performing arts written by Bharata Muni.
 
• This dance form is traditionally performed by women and is deeply rooted in Hindu mythology and spirituality.
 
 
 
• **Kuchipudi**
 
 
• Kuchipudi is a classical dance form that originated in Andhra Pradesh, India.
 
• It is known for its graceful movements, fast rhythms, and dramatic storytelling.
 
• Like Bharatanatyam, Kuchipudi also involves intricate footwork, hand gestures, and facial expressions to convey emotions and narratives.
 
• Kuchipudi performances often include both solo and group acts, and they traditionally start with a prayer to the gods.
 
 
 
• **Padma Vibhushan**
 
 
• The Padma Vibhushan is the second-highest civilian award in India, given for exceptional and distinguished service in any field.
 
• It was instituted in 1954 and is awarded to recognize excellence in various disciplines, including arts, public affairs, science, and engineering.
 
• The awardees receive a certificate signed by the President of India and a medallion.
 
• The Padma Vibhushan is part of the Padma Awards, which also include the Padma Bhushan and Padma Shri.
